name: Pichu Bros. Mini
desc: Pichu Bros. Mini? is a collection of several mini games, similar to Pokémon Party Mini.

name: Pokémon Breeder Mini
desc: Pokémon Breeder Mini (also known as Pokemon Sodateyasan Mini) is a Tamagotchi-like life simulation, in which the player cares for a young Pokémon, such as Mudkip.

name: Pokémon Party Mini
desc: Pokémon Party Mini is a collection of several minigames, including: Hitmonchan's Boxing, where you shake the system to ?punch'; Pikachu's Rocket Start, a game where you have to launch off a starting line before another Pokémon; Bellossom's Dance, a DDR-like game; Chansey's Dribble, kick the ball to the finish line as quickly as possible; Slowking's Judge, predict if the tennis ball will land in or out of the court; Sneasel's Fakeout, a rock-paper-scissors-like game for two players; Battlefield, where two to six players battle for the highest score; and Celebi's Clock, which is essentially a clock with date, alarm and stopwatch function.

name: Pokémon Pinball Mini
desc: Pokémon Pinball mini? is a pinball game with several levels where a Diglett or a Pikachu acts as the ?bumping' mechanism.

name: Pokémon Puzzle Collection
desc: Pokémon Puzzle Collection is a collection of different puzzle games such as: Shadow Puzzle, where different shapes are put together to make an image of a Pokémon; Motion Puzzle, a sliding game where an image of a Pokémon has to be unscrambled; Escape, where one has to move blocks to let a Pokémon out of a maze; and a bonus for completing most of your Minidex is the game Power On, a ?Pipe Dream'-like game where one has to connect a Pikachu to a light bulb, creating a circuit).

name: Pokémon Puzzle Collection Vol. 2
desc: Pokémon Puzzle Collection Vol. 2 is similar to the first puzzle collection, but some games are different and there are 80 new puzzles.

name: Pokémon Race Mini
desc: A traditional side-scrolling racing action game. Play as Pikachu and race against other Pokémon. If you win, more and more new Pokémon will appear.

name: Pokémon Tetris
desc: As a variation on the Tetris gameplay them, the game used the motion detection feature of the Pokémon Mini hardware for the players to rotate the falling tetrominoes, and the player received a mild force feedback response to clearing lines of blocks....

name: Pokémon Zany Cards
desc: Pokémon Zany Cards is a small collection of four card games featuring Pokémon-oriented cards.

name: Snorlax's Lunch Time
desc: Snorlax's Lunch Time is an unused Pokémon Party Mini mini game that could be found amongst the other mini games in Pokémon Channel for the Nintendo GameCube.

name: Togepi no Daibouken
desc: Togepi's Great Adventure is an adventure game in which you have to guide Togepi out of a tower, avoiding traps.
